name: Amy Lee
source:
Amy Lee is a reporter at the Rackham Gazette, Rackham City's second largest newspaper (Rackham Post being the largest). The daughter of immigrants, and the oldest of 6 siblings, Amy quickly had to find ways to help her parents with everyday expenses. She has no problem sticking her nose where it doesn't belong regardless of the potential danger that may follow. Amy is creative, stubborn, and ambitious.

[Edited from in-game description]
